executive_summary.overall_verdict: Non-blocking for basic execution. Required for full fidelity rendering and resource access.

bypass_details.title: Rendering Loop - Direct Heap Iteration

current_behavior.description: SoftwareRenderer::render() directly iterates ObjectHeap to find renderable objects
current_behavior.data_flow: ObjectHeap → C++ iteration → draw_view() → Framebuffer → PNG

expected_dex_path.description: Render loop should invoke View.draw(Canvas) via DEX invoke-virtual for each view in tree
expected_dex_path.dex_data_flow: ViewRootImpl → DecorView.draw() → LinearLayout.draw() → TextView.draw() → Canvas commands → Surface → Framebuffer

gap_analysis.what_exists: View.draw() method exists in API registry as stub
what_missing: Render loop doesn't call through interpreter
Canvas object not created via DEX
No traversal of view hierarchy via DEX methods
gap_analysis.root_cause: Render phase was implemented before DEX interpreter was functional

required_components: View tree traversal via virtual calls
Render phase integration with interpreter loop

corpus_impact.visual_impact: Output is correct but path is simulated

bypass_details.recommendation: Fix in next milestone after control flow opcodes. Current behavior produces correct output.

bypass_details.title: Layout Geometry - Hardcoded Dimensions

current_behavior.description: View bounds set to hardcoded (0, 0, 480, 800) instead of calculated from measure/layout pass
current_behavior.data_flow: Constants → set_bounds() → View.rect → Renderer uses for clipping

expected_dex_path.description: View dimensions should be calculated by measure(int, int) and layout(int, int, int, int) passes
required_opcodes: invoke-virtual for View.measure(int widthSpec, int heightSpec)
invoke-virtual for View.layout(int left, int top, int right, int bottom)
invoke-static for View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(int size, int mode)
expected_dex_path.dex_data_flow: ViewRootImpl.performTraversals() → View.measure(widthSpec, heightSpec) → View.onMeasure() → View.layout(l,t,r,b) → View.onLayout() → View.mLeft/Top/Right/Bottom set

what_exists: measure()/layout() stubs exist in API registry
gap_analysis.root_cause: Layout system requires recursive measurement which needs working control flow (loops)

dependencies: Control flow opcodes (goto, if-*) MUST be implemented first

corpus_impact.apps_affected: All apps with multiple views or complex layouts (~8/12 = 67%)
corpus_impact.visual_impact: Views may overlap or have wrong sizes if layout is complex
corpus_impact.functional_impact: LOW for single-fullscreen views (HelloWorld works fine)

bypass_details.recommendation: Defer until after control flow implementation. Current hardcoded bounds work for simple layouts.

bypass_details.title: Resource Loading - C++ Parser Shortcut

current_behavior.description: Resource values extracted by C++ ResourceParser instead of Context.getResources().getString(id) dispatch
current_behavior.data_flow: resources.arsc → C++ ResourceParser.extract_strings() → Map<int,string> → Direct lookup

expected_dex_path.description: Resources should be accessed through standard Android resource API chain
required_opcodes: const for R class field references
expected_dex_path.dex_data_flow: Activity.getResources() → Resources.mResources → Resources.getString(resId) → StringBlock.get(resId) → Value returned to register

what_exists: ResourceParser can extract all string resources
getString() works when called with correct ID
what_missing: Resource access not dispatched from DEX interpreter
TypedArray support missing for attribute resources
gap_analysis.root_cause: Resources object not wired into Activity context properly

required_components: Bridge from DEX getResources() to existing ResourceParser

corpus_impact.visual_impact: NONE - values are correct, just loading path differs

bypass_details.recommendation: Good candidate for quick fix. Low complexity, high correctness improvement. Can fix alongside sget-object implementation.

strict_mode_impact.notes: If all 3 remaining bypasses fixed, strict mode would achieve perfect score

BYPASS-006_evidence_needed: Trace showing getResources() invoked via DEX
Trace showing getString(R.id.xxx) returning correct value
Register state showing value from DEX, not C++ injection
BYPASS-005_evidence_needed: Trace showing measure(widthSpec, heightSpec) called for each view
Trace showing layout(l,t,r,b) setting proper coordinates
Final bounds matching expected layout (not hardcoded)
BYPASS-004_evidence_needed: Trace showing draw(canvas) invoked via invoke-virtual for root view
Trace showing child views receiving draw() recursively
Canvas operations (drawText, drawRect) coming from DEX dispatch

verdict: Three bypasses remain, none blocking basic functionality. BYPASS-006 recommended for next sprint. BYPASS-005 and BYPASS-004 require control flow infrastructure first. All honestly documented per Golden Debug Protocol.
